items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 I downloaded this app quite recently and
items.summary: I downloaded this app quite recently and it is genuinely so much fun! The art is gorgeous and the story is really interesting as well. Now, I have read some of the comments regarding the card pull system and honestly it is far better than any other game I have played. I got multiple SSRs within the first few days since it was installed and it is pretty easy to get the things needed to do the pulls as well. So over all, I would 100% recommend this game!

items.summary: So far this game is really interesting, it's very F2p friendly and doesn't take that much space on mobile, though I wish there were voice lines in the story so that we could understand the story better but I'm quite happy with the story and the plot itself. knowing this game isn't really a main stream, I don't really mind the lack of VA tbh and hopefully this game will get the recognition it deserves in the future 🗝️
